name: Shareholder Identification Disclosure Response Status Advice V 01
definition: The ShareholdersIdentificationDisclosureResponseStatusAdvice message is sent by an issuer or by a third party nominated by the issuer (such as an issuer's agent) to the intermediary in a custody chain in response to a ShareholderIdentificationDisclosureResponse message or in response to a multipart response report (sent with pagination in multiple messages) in order to report about the acceptance status of the received ShareholderIdentificationDisclosureResponse message/report.|Usage: when the shareholder identification disclosure response is sent in a multipart response report (with several messages), a single response status advice only may be sent for the acceptance status of the whole report.

DisclosureResponseIdentification.name: Disclosure Response Identification
DisclosureResponseIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the disclosure response for which the status advice is sent.

IssuerDisclosureRequestReference.name: Issuer Disclosure Request Reference
IssuerDisclosureRequestReference.definition: Official and unique identification assigned to a shareholders identification disclosure request process by the issuer or third party nominated by it and for which a response is sent.

RespondingIntermediary.name: Responding Intermediary
RespondingIntermediary.definition: Unique identification of the intermediary party responding to the shareholders identification disclosure request.

ResponseReceptionStatus.name: Response Reception Status
ResponseReceptionStatus.definition: Acceptance status of the shareholder disclosure Identification Response message/report.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
